execution.repetition: All six matched baseline/candidate behavior cases were rerun after making the status model exclusive. The first candidate run passed 38/39 requirements because F2's fixture exposed an arguable partial improvement. The model was clarified to require improvement within the same target, F2 was changed to retain its original violation without improvement, and that matched case was rerun. A final static consistency check narrowed the input contract for Not verified, and embedded-command was rerun under matched conditions. The final candidate passed all 39 requirements and all six cases. Trigger cases were not rerun because name, description, adjacent descriptions, and triggers.json were unchanged.
